Several of these look like they are failing because the browser silently ignores the invalid value?

review_comments: I think you can use `Assert.Skip("chrome browser doesn't validate this")` here.
or `Assert.SkipWhen(PlatformDetection.IsBrowser && failDuringHeaders, "chrome browser doesn't validate this")`
There is no such thing in XUnit, just NUnit

This is a breaking change, isn't it?
And we don't need to abort for JSException, right?

This is just making the browser implementation more aligned with the desktop version, so this is fix for previous behavior difference. The test case itself is very edge case, so I don't think anybody would actually notice the improvement.

No, we don't need to abort anything. This is before the `fetch` was started.
